title: eludite.editor.surround_with input
description: Surround the selection with a code snippet (Edit > IntelliSense > Surround With, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+S; brief 0069): a snippet whose kinds include `surroundsWith` (`if`, `try`, `for`, `region`...), with the selected text where it says `$selected$`. Without `shortcut`, the Surround With picker opens.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
